body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, the enemy has -1 on its next Success Die against an ally other than you until the start of your next turn. Independently, reduce your next incoming Damage from that enemy by 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, it becomes Distracted until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Vow
rider.html: Vow: remain within 3 units of the enemy until your next turn. Spend this Authority when it attacks an ally to give that ally +1 to the targeted Defense; leaving voluntarily discards it.
